## 2025-05-14 - Fix Reverse Tabnabbing Vulnerability in Markdown Generator
**Vulnerability:** External links generated by python scripts using Kramdown inline attributes `{:target="_blank"}` lacked the `rel="noopener noreferrer"` attribute.
**Learning:** Automatically generating markdown links with `target="_blank"` without proper `rel` attributes exposes the final generated site to reverse tabnabbing attacks, allowing compromised external pages to hijack the user's origin tab.
**Prevention:** Always include `rel="noopener noreferrer"` when programmatically generating external markdown or HTML links that open in a new tab.
